verdict.rationale: Automation rules are a fair axis for a note-taking and knowledge app, but the evidence shows no user-definable event-triggered rule system, webhooks, or trigger/action builder. The closest items are narrow and not rule-based: a fixed scheduled full export, templates that prefill content, AI property auto-fill, and an unexplained "Task actions" pricing line. The REST API and MCP integrations would only let external tools build automation outside the product.
